q: The stabilizer formalism for quantum error correction uses an Abelian group S ⊂ Pauli group P_n. The code space is the +1 eigenspace of all elements of S. The code encodes k qubits into n qubits if |S| =
exp: |S| = 2^{n-k}: S has n-k generators (independent Pauli operators), giving 2^k-dimensional code space (the +1 eigenspace of all 2^{n-k} generators). The code distance is the minimum weight of a Pauli in the normalizer N(S) not in S.
